data: 12 controlled histories H01/H02/H03 x SA/SB x fast/slow
protocol: multi-threshold whiff onset/offset counts, inter-event gaps, burst durations and derivative events; source probe trained on fast wind and evaluated on later slow wind; windows 5/10/20 s; three held-time configurations
decision: simple event summaries do not support event/TPP as the main innovation
event timing remains physically relevant but cannot be promoted without a stronger candidate-conditioned event-process likelihood
